title: 题型与解题步骤
goal: 按步骤复述一句话；判断一次复述的失分类型。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断一次复述的失分类型

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、计分、自适应

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 题目说明和官方样题（挖空规则是对照样题和答案看出来的）

body.p: Listen and Repeat 要求听完一句后原样复述。句子逐渐变长，结构逐渐复杂。复述要保留原词、语序和完整的意思，不能改成概括。

body.box:
The practice room is upstairs.
The practice room beside the lift is available after lunch.

body.p: 第二句在房间名称后加了位置，在谓语后加了时间。加上的部分也要说出。只说 The practice room is available，没有复述整句。

cards.title: 解题步骤

steps.d: 先确定谁做什么，再辨认否定、数量和时间。The parcel has not arrived 中的 not 说明包裹还没到。
把相邻的词按意思分成短语来记。短语里的词不换成近义词。The parcel / has not arrived 分成主语和完整的谓语两段。
按原句的意群顺序和节奏说出，功能词和词尾都要保留。The parcels have arrived 中，parcels 和 have 都不能说成单数形式。

cards.note: 以上为本课程的建议，不是官方规定

cards.title: 完整性与准确性
rows: 主语
保留主语的身份和单复数。
The visitor waits. / The visitors wait.
谓语
保留时态和助动词，不能只留主要动词。
The clerk has checked the list.
否定
not 改变句子的意思。它读得轻，也不能省。
The door is not locked.
限定词
a、the、this 也是原词，不能换。
Please use the marked envelope.
修饰语
原句的时间和地点都要说出，不能只说主干。
The rehearsal starts after lunch.
可懂度
词说全了，发音还要能听清。
The files are ready.（files 的词尾须清楚）

body.box: The astronomy club meets in the small dome after sunset.

Proposed repetition: The astronomy club meets in the dome after sunset.
Which change occurred?
1. A location was moved.
2. A describing word was omitted.
3. The meeting time was replaced.
4. The sentence stopped before the verb.

body.p: 原句的 in the small dome 是地点意群，after sunset 是时间意群。复述保留了地点和时间的顺序，但漏了 small。答案是第二项。
the dome 仍然说出了地点，但不是原样复述。检查时逐词对照原句，不只看句子是否通顺。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 漏词
The new badge is ready. → The badge is ready.
漏了 new，后面的内容都说了。
换词
The new badge is ready. → The new card is ready.
badge 换成了 card。意思相近的词也不是原词。
改语序
The new badge is ready today. → Today the new badge is ready.
词语保留，但 today 移到句首。
中途停住
The new badge is ready today. → The new badge …
谓语和后面的内容都没说出。
cards.note: 这四类用来分析复述哪里有变化，不直接对应官方分数。

lines.text: The pottery course begins on Wednesday.

items.why: 原句 The pottery course begins on Wednesday 中，begins 与单数主语 course 一致。on Wednesday 是时间短语。

lines.text: The bicycle rack is behind the greenhouse.

items.why: 原句位置是 behind the greenhouse，beside 会改变空间关系。

lines.text: The puzzle contest starts before dinner.

items.stem: The repetition is "The contest starts before dinner." What changed?
options: The time was moved to the beginning.
A word identifying the contest was dropped.
The action was replaced by another action.
The response stopped before the action.
items.why: The puzzle contest 中的 puzzle 被省略，starts before dinner 仍完整保留。

lines.text: The sculptor needs a narrower chisel.

items.stem: The repetition is "The sculptor needs a wider chisel." What changed?
options: The word chisel was omitted.
The word needs was moved.
The response ended before chisel.
The description of the chisel was replaced.
items.why: narrower 换成了 wider，属于换词，意思也相反了。其他词都保留了。

lines.text: The hiking permit expires at midnight.

items.why: 原句 expires at midnight 使用一般现在时；expired 改变时态。

lines.text: All donated blankets must remain in this cupboard.

items.stem: Put the heard chunks in their original order.
items.why: 原句 this cupboard 指示当前橱柜，不能替换成 that cupboard。

lines.text: The debate begins after the final announcement.

items.stem: The repetition is "After the final announcement, the debate begins." What changed?
options: The time phrase was placed first.
The final announcement was omitted.
The word debate was replaced.
The response stopped before the main action.
items.why: after the final announcement 从句尾移到了句首。词都在，语序变了。

lines.text: The garden volunteers will measure the new plots.

items.stem: The repetition is "The garden volunteers will ..." What happened?
options: A complete time phrase changed position.
A full description replaced another description.
The response ended before completing the action.
A modifier was removed from a completed sentence.
items.why: 复述停在 will 后面，measure the new plots 没有说出。这是中途停住，不是漏掉一个修饰语。

lines.text: The rowing team stores its oars beside the landing.

items.why: 原句 its oars 的 its 指 the rowing team，不能换成 their。

lines.text: The translation booth opens before the keynote session.

items.why: 原句是 before the keynote session，after 的意思正好相反。

lines.text: The compost workshop has moved to the west courtyard.

items.stem: Put the heard chunks in their original order.
items.why: 原句 has moved 的助动词是 has，不能改成 had。

lines.text: The chess final will resume after the break.

items.stem: Reconstruct the sentence from the recording.
items.why: 原句是 will resume after the break，before 改变了时间关系。

lines.text: The ceramic tiles are stored beneath the stairs.

items.stem: The repetition is "The tiles are stored beneath the stairs." Which error occurred?
options: Omitting the word that describes the tiles
Replacing the location with a different location
Moving the location before the subject
Stopping before the storage location is given
items.why: The ceramic tiles 中的 ceramic 被漏掉，位置 beneath the stairs 仍在句尾。

lines.text: The photography tutor expects a printed portfolio.

items.stem: The repetition is "The photography tutor expects a digital portfolio." Which error occurred?
options: Dropping the noun naming the required submission
Replacing the description of the required submission
Moving the required submission before the tutor
Ending the response before describing the submission
items.why: printed 换成了 digital，提交的形式变了。portfolio 仍在。

lines.text: The fencing lesson finishes before the hall closes.

items.stem: The repetition is "Before the hall closes, the fencing lesson finishes." Which error occurred?
options: Leaving out the part about the hall
Replacing the action performed in the hall
Moving the time clause before the main clause
Stopping before the fencing lesson is mentioned
items.why: before the hall closes 被移到了句首。词和意思都在，语序变了。

lines.text: The student choir will perform in the eastern courtyard.

items.stem: The repetition is "The student choir will ..." Which description fits?
options: The location was moved ahead of the choir.
The performance was changed to another event.
A location word was dropped from a complete sentence.
The response stopped before the predicate was complete.
items.why: 复述停在 will，perform in the eastern courtyard 未说出，谓语没有完成。
